noForkDraft.productPurpose: Show a user-entered calendar date in a fixed, readable format without storage or network access.
targetUsers: A learner practicing pure TypeScript date formatting
noForkDraft.primaryUsageMoment: When checking the display of one date they entered locally.
noForkDraft.successMoment: The entered date appears in the specified format with a clear invalid-input message.
mvpFeatures: Display the specified formatted date or an invalid-input message

scope.title: Pure date formatting
scope.rationale: The visible result follows from the input without a hidden current-time dependency.

scope.title: Local page shell
scope.rationale: A small form is needed to try the formatter but is not the learning target.

scope.title: Persistence and network data
scope.rationale: The specified one-input behavior does not need either boundary.
